verdict.rationale: Pipedream's trigger docs list Schedule as a first-class workflow trigger alongside HTTP, Email and RSS. A Hacker News comment independently corroborates cron-triggered executions, noting a 30s per-execution limit for cron. Automatic retries and error-email notifications support running recurring jobs unattended. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule configuration (cron syntax, intervals, time zones), evidence that schedules can be created programmatically via the REST API, CLI or MCP for AI-native workflows, and current hands-on corroboration (the cron limits come from an old 2019 thread).
